name: Supine Twist

frames.label: Start
frames.cue: Lie on your back, bend your knees, and open your arms.

frames.label: Knees Together
frames.cue: Bring your knees together and gently lift them.

frames.label: Right Twist Hold
frames.cue: Lower both knees to the right. Keep both shoulders grounded.

frames.label: Center Reset
frames.cue: Return your knees slowly to center.

frames.label: Left Twist
frames.cue: Lower both knees gently to the left.

frames.label: Left Twist Hold
frames.cue: Hold the left twist with both shoulders relaxed on the floor.

safety: Move only within a comfortable range and keep both shoulders grounded.
Place a pillow under the knees if they do not comfortably reach the floor.
Stop if the movement causes sharp back, hip, or knee pain.

aiCoachNote.prompt: How did the Supine Twist feel? Note which side felt tighter and any back, hip, or knee discomfort.
